# langsmith_org (Data Source)

Reads the current LangSmith organization from the authenticated provider context.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp when returned by the API.
- `display_name` (String) Organization display name.
- `handle` (String) Organization handle when returned by the API.
- `id` (String) Organization ID.
